notes.title: Update is coming!
notes.notes:
[h3]The work on the "Pathfinder" set is complete! [/h3] [i] (bonus set for players who bought the game)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/4c0800fcf2495ab1cd781698ca1282f58e5bf276.gif[/img]

[h3]Work on the location "Suicide Island" is complete![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/99bc45f65feedd4739c1f58398598c6acd445262.png[/img]

[b]I are finishing work on character statistics, soon you will be able to track the full state of your characters and satisfy all their needs![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/1c2bbe1bc10367e580efa31d1468833cc726b313.jpg[/img]

[b]I are finishing work on viruses and monitoring detailed statistics about the health of the characters, soon you will be able to completely control the incidence and spread of viruses among your survivors![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/4dd64dc8a6373ca2fff5f8b85835c9af08a98064.jpg[/img]

[b]After finishing work on the above points, I'm going to finalize 3 planned locations:[/b]
[olist][*]Sea of Sins
[*]Hermit Mountains
[*]Dump [i](bonus location for players who bought the game)[/i][/olist]

[b]After finishing work on the locations, I plan to upload this big update to Steam, in addition to all of the above, this update will contain many more various improvements and changes, starting with the display of the characteristics of items in the warehouse and ending with a modified landscape of the "desert of death" with new shaders.[/b]

[u][h2]IMPORTANT![/h2][/u]
[b][i]Due to the large number of changes and the introduction of new mechanics, I'm afraid that there may be a lot of bugs and errors, so I'm thinking about making a test branch to test some individual changes before the full update is released.[/i][/b]

[b][u][h3]ATTENTION![/h3]
Due to the introduction of new mechanics, after installing the update, you will have to do a full reset of all game progress in the game settings menu.[/u]

[i]What are your thoughts on the test branch and early testing of updates?[/i][/b]

notes.title: Switching to the free version
notes.notes:
[i][h2]Hello![/h2]
[b]I would like this announcement to start more optimistically and contain information about game innovations, new content, new mechanics, but not everything is so rosy.
Due to some difficulties that arose, work on this project was temporarily stopped, for an indefinite period. [/b]

[b][h3]Therefore, it was decided to open access to the game for everyone by transferring it to the free section![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/d5df2f24b4c679551d59a88bbe39c79604f858ae.png[/img]

[u]But, this does not mean that the work on the game has stopped forever! I have big plans for this project, revision of existing game mechanics, expansion of the game world, replenishment of content, new game mechanics, all this is in my plans![/u]

[h3]To help my work on this project, each of you can still 
 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33179152-BadWolf-Games/] by purchasing my other projects[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/1067810/browse/?filter=all]in-game items[/url]![/h3][/i]
